pages.observed: Five-frame contact sheet 0.0 to 0.8s of a vertical airport curb scene. A phone showing a map route and Ride requested card hovers left, an airport pickup sign stands right, a white car sits at left edge, bench and teal suitcase on sidewalk, skyline behind. Caption appears from 0.6s. Frames nearly identical, little motion.

Contact sheet 1.0 to 1.8s. The white car with roof sensor pod rolls in from the left, red brake light on, and settles into the pickup bay box. Phone card still says Ride requested. Caption stays on two lines at lower third. Lower half of frame is empty dark asphalt.

Contact sheet 2.0 to 2.8s. Exterior car stops in bay, Texas outline card appears top right at 2.2s, then hard cut at 2.4s to an interior view with steering wheel, empty seats and dashboard map screen. Steering wheel appears to rotate slightly between 2.6 and 2.8s. Phone card from exterior stays overlaid on the interior view.

Contact sheet 3.0 to 3.8s of the interior cab view. Steering wheel turns by itself with empty seats, airport sign passes outward through windshield, Texas outline card draws its border. Lower half of the frame shows empty seat backs below caption.

Contact sheet 4.0 to 4.8s. Interior cab view is mostly static for 4.0 to 4.4s with caption. At 4.6s the caption has dropped away. At 4.8s the picture cuts to the exterior curb with the phone enlarged and tilted in front of the car at the bay. Phone still reads Ride requested, Finding a car.

Contact sheet 5.0 to 5.8s. Exterior curb with the enlarged tilted phone partly covering the white car. Phone label switches from Ride requested to Arriving At the curb at 5.6s while the pin reaches the curb point. Caption now reads the airport included. Texas card shows orange dot in San Antonio area then a ring.

Contact sheet 6.0 to 6.8s. The curb scene holds with the phone saying Arriving At the curb and the car at the bay, no change for about 0.6s. At 6.8s hard cut to a wooden desk top view in perspective with a paper street map, three small pins and a February calendar tag. Wood desk occupies a trapezoid on a blurred scenery backdrop.

Contact sheet 7.0 to 7.8s. Wooden desk with paper map, small pins and a February calendar. Map is static for 0.6s then blue river lines and orange road lines draw in at 7.6 and 7.8s. Caption The service began in February. Map is small in the frame, upper-middle, with wide empty wood below caption.

Contact sheet 8.0 to 8.8s. Map on the desk gains an orange oval service outline plus crossing orange roads and a wiggling blue river. The Texas locator fades out at 8.2s. Caption still The service began in February. Map still occupies a small area in the middle of the frame with large empty desk below.

Contact sheet 9.0 to 9.8s. Camera moves up over the desk so the map becomes larger. A February calendar page flips onto the map and drifts to the lower left. A thin black trace stroke begins along the top of the oval outline. Caption changes to in a limited area of sixty square miles at 9.4s. No visible sixty square miles tag yet.

Contact sheet 10.0 to 10.8s. Map with orange oval is nearly static; only a thin black stroke extends slowly along the top of the oval. No tag reading sixty square miles is visible. Calendar page rests lower left. Large empty wood desk below caption.

Contact sheet 11.0 to 11.8s. The black service outline closes around the pins and fills gray. A tag reading 60 square miles, Limited area drops onto the map at 11.2s and settles. Frame holds from 11.4 to 11.8s with the tag, map, calendar and caption.

Contact sheet 12.0 to 12.8s. Map held for 0.4s then cut to a brown flood scene: a small white car half in the water far from the camera, rain streaks, trees and a skyline behind, stone steps at the right edge. Caption begins at 12.8s. Car is small in frame, below it is a large expanse of brown water.

Contact sheet 13.0 to 13.8s. The small half-submerged white car sits in nearly the same place in each sample while rain lines move. Brown water fills the lower half and the car occupies a small part of the frame. Cabin emptiness cannot be read at this size. No clear sweeping motion yet.

Contact sheet 14.0 to 14.8s. Wide creek frame stays almost unchanged for 14.0 to 14.6s with only rain streaks moving. At 14.8s the picture cuts to a closer medium view of the same car half in water with a small wake and a reflection, still level and upright. Car windows are dark, cabin is not clearly visible.

Contact sheet 15.0 to 15.8s. Medium shot of the car in brown water with an empty cabin visible through side windows. The car edges slowly to the right with a small wake and a slight tilt by 15.8s. Motion is slight. Caption in lower third over the water.

Contact sheet 16.0 to 16.8s. The white car moves left through brown water with a visible wake and mud line on its lower door, upright and level. Cabin windows show empty dark seats. Caption ends around 16.5s and is gone by 16.6s. Car remains in the middle third of the frame, large water area under it.

Contact sheet 17.0 to 17.8s. Creek car leaves the left of frame by 17.2s. At 17.4s hard cut to a suburban street: low houses, tree, street sign, a white car on asphalt with brown water pooled at the left and wheels not yet submerged. Caption appears at 17.6s. Car occupies a small band mid-frame, large paved sidewalk below.

Contact sheet 18.0 to 18.8s. Floodwater visibly spreads across the street from left to right and rises to the lower wheel arches of the white car by 18.4s, then holds. Car is stationary in the water. Caption lower third. No hazard lamp blinking is evident in these samples.

Contact sheet 19.0 to 19.8s. The white car sits in brown water as amber hazard lamps blink at 19.2 and 19.4s, off at 19.6s. At 19.8s the shot cuts to a closer framing with a blurred background, the car larger and level in water with wheels covered and reflection below.

Contact sheet 20.0 to 20.8s. Closer view of the stranded car in floodwater with blurred background. Hazard lamps blink at the front and rear. Cabin windows are dark with seat shapes, no occupant. Nothing else changes. Caption stays on the lower third. A wide empty sidewalk occupies the lower third.

Contact sheet 21.0 to 21.8s. The stranded white car holds in floodwater with only the hazard lamps blinking. Caption ends by 21.4s and the frame is captionless to 21.8s. Roughly 2.4s of this scene since 19.8 is a held close view with only lamp flicker.

Contact sheet 22.0 to 22.8s. Flood scene ends at 22.0s, then at 22.2s hard cut to a desk with a Federal recall record card, blank ruled lines, pen at lower right, olive backdrop. Card sits at upper right, partly cropped at the right edge. Caption Waymo filed a software recall at 22.6s. Large empty olive area at bottom.

Contact sheet 23.0 to 23.8s. The recall card slides to center and its field rows type in one by one: Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791 (label and number slightly overlap), then a Summary paragraph about slowing and driving into standing water. Field text is very small at phone size. Large empty olive area below the caption.

Contact sheet 24.0 to 24.8s. Card text rows type in through 24.6s, filling the card with small text. At 24.8s hard cut to a higher view of the desk with a smaller card above and a grid of dashed car slots with four white car icons filled at upper left. Caption changes to that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. Card text is tiny at phone size.

Contact sheet 25.0 to 25.8s. The grid fills with small white car icons row by row while a hand holding a rubber stamp descends from the top right toward the recall card, landing at 25.8s over the card header. No counter tag with 3,791 visible yet. Card text is tiny.

Contact sheet 26.0 to 26.8s. The stamp lands on the recall card leaving an orange Software recall mark. A counter tag Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record fades in beside it at 26.2s and settles. The tag overlaps the left edge of the card and partly hides its fields. Car grid is full and unchanged. Frame holds at 26.6 to 26.8s.

Contact sheet 27.0 to 27.8s. Every sample shows the same held arrangement: the recall card with its stamp, the counter tag and the full car grid. Nothing moves for the whole page, about 1.4s of a hold with 0.8s from 26.6 already static. Caption disappears at 27.6s.

Contact sheet 28.0 to 28.8s. Cut from the desk to a roadside scene: white car enters from the left on a gray road, a quote card from the recall appears top left. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow. Large olive green grass band fills the lower part of frame below the caption.

Contact sheet 29.0 to 29.8s. The white car drives along a gray road in a treadmill-style pan with lane dashes sliding by and a lamp post leaving. Quote card with the recall sentence sits top left. No water on the road yet and no brake lamp. Lower half of the frame is a plain green grass area.

Contact sheet 30.0 to 30.8s. The car's red brake lamp lights and a gray puddle slides in from the right on the road ahead. The car keeps roughly the same screen position while the scenery scrolls. Quote card unchanged. The 'may' word is not highlighted yet.

Contact sheet 31.0 to 31.8s. Wide road view with the car and puddle, then at 31.6s a cut to a close side view of the car larger in frame with thin wake lines at the wheels and the puddle edge appearing at right. Caption changes to then drive into standing water on higher speed roads at 31.8s. Quote card unchanged.

Contact sheet 32.0 to 32.8s. Close side view of the white car with red brake lamp lit. A gray puddle slides in from the right toward the front wheel, touching the car's nose at 32.8s while the word may on the card gets an amber highlight. Car body is held in place with wake lines under the wheels.

Contact sheet 33.0 to 33.8s. The white car in close side view rolls into standing water: the gray puddle spreads under and past the front wheel with ripples and small splashes from 33.4s. The amber highlight on the word may holds on the quote card. Car stays in place while the road scrolls.

Contact sheet 34.0 to 34.8s. The white car rolls through standing water with ongoing wake lines and splash, water reflection beneath. The may highlight holds on the quote card. A vertical post appears at the right edge at 34.8s. Caption over the lower third, large olive band below.

Contact sheet 35.0 to 35.8s. The car and water scene continues to 35.4s, then at 35.6s hard cut to a larger recall record card on the desk with the Software recall stamp across the top fields. All rows readable at larger size: Remedy is currently under development. The stamp overlaps the Recall type and Potential units rows. Caption starts at 35.8s.

Contact sheet 36.0 to 36.8s. Same recall card, the Remedy row gains an amber highlight and bar progressively from 36.0 to 36.4s and holds. A pen tip begins entering at the right edge at 36.8s. Caption holds. The stamp still overlaps the units figure 3,791.

Contact sheet 37.0 to 37.8s. A hand with a pen reaches in from the right and points near the Interim remedy row, then withdraws by 37.6s. At 37.8s the card enlarges and a hand holding a rubber stamp descends from the top right, over the Software recall stamp mark rather than over the Remedy row. Caption unchanged.

Contact sheet 38.0 to 38.4s the stamp with arm descends over the Summary lines. At 38.6s it presses on the Remedy row and an orange Under development stamp appears crookedly across the highlighted row, partly covering its text. At 38.8s the stamp lifts and the mark holds. The stamp hand and arm are large and cover the record's Summary text during the descent.

Contact sheet 39.0 to 39.8s. The stamp and arm lift away. The Under development mark stays crooked across the Remedy row and partly covers its text. Caption ends by 39.4s. The card holds static from 39.6 to 39.8s, with the lower half of the frame empty olive and desk.

Contact sheet 40.0 to 40.8s after a cut at 40.0s to a wide parking lot. Four small white cars in a row at the middle, an April calendar and a Vehicle maps card at left, poles and wire above. Frames are identical for the whole 0.8s; no weather tag or cloud and rain icon is visible. Cars are small in a mostly empty gray lot.

Contact sheet 41.0 to 41.8s. The parking lot view is unchanged for 0.4s, then a Weather limits tightened tag with a cloud and rain icon slides in from the left at 41.4s and settles near the top of the April card by 41.6 and 41.8s. Cars stay small in the row.

Contact sheet 42.0 to 42.8s. All five samples are identical: the Weather limits tag over the April card and four small white cars in the lot. No object moves for the full 0.8s, after the 0.6s hold before it. Large empty gray lower half of frame.

Contact sheet 43.0 to 43.8s. Frame identical from 43.0 to 43.4s, then a slow camera push in begins at 43.6s. Caption changes at 43.8s to the April twentieth clause. April calendar page is still blank lines, not yet showing April 20. The cars remain small and without check marks.

Contact sheet 44.0 to 44.8s. The April calendar flips to show 20 with a leaf animation at the top, then settles by 44.6s. Weather limits tag and Vehicle maps card unchanged. The four cars are still small and unmarked; no check marks yet.

Contact sheet 45.0 to 45.8s. After a 0.4s static hold the check marks begin: a circle appears above the first car at 45.4s, becomes a check at 45.6s, then the second car gets a circle and then a check by 45.8s. Cars remain small in the frame, check badges are small.

Contact sheet 46.0 to 46.8s. Check marks reach all four cars by 46.2s and the Vehicle maps card is marked updated. From 46.4 to 46.8s the frame is static with all checks in place. Check badges are small and the cars are small in the frame.

Contact sheet 47.0 to 47.8s. The checked lot scene holds static for 47.0 to 47.6s and caption clears at 47.2s. At 47.8s hard cut back to the airport curb: white car at the bay, phone at upper left reading Arriving At the curb, airport sign, bench, suitcase. New badge says A generic airport ride, not the flood cars.

Contact sheet 48.0 to 48.8s. White car sits at the curb bay under the phone card that reads Arriving At the curb. Rear door starts opening at 48.6s and is open by 48.8s. Caption So the airport ride is open. Lower half of the frame is empty dark asphalt.

Contact sheet 49.0 to 49.8s. The car holds at the bay with its rear door open. Everything is static across the five samples. Caption ends by 49.8s. No person enters or exits. Lower half of frame is empty asphalt.

Contact sheet 50.0 to 50.8s. Closer view of the curb: car with open rear door at the bay, a bench with a phone and a suitcase, and a Federal recall record card placed on the asphalt in front with the Remedy row and an Under development stamp. Nothing moves during the 0.8s apart from the caption starting. The card text is small.

Contact sheet 51.0 to 51.8s. The recall card in the foreground grows and its Remedy row highlights amber, then it slides to the left side lower on the road by 51.6s. The text The remedy is currently under development is readable. The car with open door remains static behind. Card sits partly over the road, not on a surface.

Contact sheet 52.0 to 52.8s. Every sample is the same: card lower left with the highlighted Remedy row and stamp, car with open door at the curb behind. Nothing moves except the caption switching at 52.8s. The lower half of the frame is empty dark asphalt.

Contact sheet 53.0 to 53.8s. A split screen: top half the open-door car at the curb, bottom half a desk showing the recall card with the Remedy row beside a phone reading Arriving At the curb. A black underline draws beneath the words under development across 53.2 to 53.6s. Everything else is static. Lower third of the frame is empty brown desk.

Contact sheet 54.0 to 54.8s. Static split frame: car with open door above, recall card and phone below. Caption disappears by 54.2s. No object moves in any of the five samples, which continue the static hold since 53.6s. The lower third is empty brown desk.

Contact sheet 55.0 to 55.8s. All five samples identical: the held closing split frame with the car at the curb, recall card with Remedy row and phone. No caption present. No movement. This continues the static hold from 53.6s, now about 2.2s.

Contact sheet 56.0 to 56.8s. Hard cut from the held split frame to a dark credit card; the Texas flag and title fade up from gray in the first 0.2s. All source and credit lines are legible at this scale though small. The lower 40 percent of the frame is empty dark.

Contact sheet 57.0 to 57.8s. The credit card is identical in all five samples. Flag, title, link, source, illustration, map and music lines are all legible but small. No motion. Lower 40 percent of the frame empty dark.
Contact sheet 58.0 to 58.8s. Identical to the previous credit pages: static credit card with all lines unchanged and no motion.
Contact sheet 59.0 to 59.8s. Identical static credit card, all lines unchanged, no motion.
Contact sheet 60.0 to 60.8s. Identical static credit card, all lines unchanged, no motion.
Final frame 1829 at 60.967s. Static dark credit card with Texas flag, title, link and all credit lines, identical to the preceding credit samples. No visible fade-out.
